description: This Java class defines a specific exception type called ResourcesNotModifiableException, which is thrown when resources within a policy cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and has an associated builder class for flexible construction.

classes.name: ResourcesNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception when resources of a policy cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions.

classes.name: ResourcesNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ResourcesNotModifiableException instances with a fluent API, marked as not thread-safe.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesNotModifiableException using a provided message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourcesNotModifiableException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the specified headers.
